name: usitc-tariffs-mcp-server
description: Search USITC tariff schedules, inspect heading trees, and look up published duty rates via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search USITC tariff schedules, inspect heading trees, and look up published duty rates via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Search the U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule by commodity description or code prefix, inspect legal ancestry, and retrieve the published General, Special, and Column 2 duty columns. Decode edition-pinned Special Program Indicators while keeping country membership and qualification unresolved. Investigate partial Chapter 99 candidate evidence with complete supporting passages and source provenance; empty candidates never establish clearance. Results do not determine current legal enforceability, select a duty column, or calculate combined duties.
